claims.statement: Tom Allen advertised a free concert every evening at 619 Market Street.
claims.excerpt: Tem ALLEN, retired champion pugilist of the worid, 619 Market street. Free concert every evening, Best of singers only engaged here.

claims.statement: Tom Allen was advertised as the retired champion pugilist of the world.
claims.excerpt: Tem ALLEN, retired champion pugilist of the worid, 619 Market street.

notes: Advertisement. Text says 'Tem ALLEN' (OCR for Tom) and 'worid' (OCR for world).
